crossRefs.note: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities, and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is…
Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and…
He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock; in the lowland also, and in…
Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim…
Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

translations.web: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
translations.bsb: He also built cities in the hill country of Judah and fortresses and towers in the forests.
translations.kjv: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
translations.asv: Moreover he built cities in the hill-country of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
